description: This file defines kernel package configurations for various SPI-related modules in the OpenWrt project, including support for MMC/SD over SPI, SPI bitbanging libraries, GPIO-based SPI master, user mode SPI device driver, and DesignWare SPI controllers. It primarily contains build instructions, dependencies, and metadata for kernel modules.

methods.name: KernelPackage/mmc-spi
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for MMC/SD over SPI support including dependencies, configuration, files, and auto-loading behavior.

methods.name: KernelPackage/spi-bitbang
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for the SPI bitbanging library, including configuration and associated files.

methods.name: KernelPackage/spi-gpio
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for GPIO-based SPI master, including dependencies, configuration, files, and auto-probing setup.

methods.name: KernelPackage/spi-dev
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for user mode SPI device driver, with relevant configuration, files, and auto-probing.

methods.name: KernelPackage/spi-dw
methods.description: Defines the core driver for the DesignWare SPI controller, including configuration, files, and auto-probing.

methods.name: KernelPackage/spi-dw-mmio
methods.description: Defines the MMIO variant of the DesignWare SPI driver, with dependencies and auto-probing setup.
